reviewDescription: Pros and things I liked: I opened the package and found these buds to look and feel high end. The charging station is metal and heavier than many other cases that I've had, but not too heavy. This is not a negative but I'm thinking if you dropped it, your ear buds would stay unharmed and it might not break. I ordered the champagne color which was beautiful. Once they are in the ears they are practically not noticible. They fit in my ear fine, and they come with an array of silicone buds for any ear canal size which makes these very versatile. This is really a huge bonus of these buds. Easy to change out the silicone buds. They canceled noise easily and I barely heard my phone ring that it was not paired to and sitting on the table next to me. The value for the money seems to be amazing as they feel like a much more expensive brand. I tested them on a full charge on my computer, 1 phone, 1 tablet and Smart TV. They paired effortlessly an the battery life was great, and I didn't need to recharge them after a full day of use. They don't seem to put a drain on my phone battery. All in all these sounded wonderful and clear. The bass boost was not that noticible but it is there and they did not sound cheap and tinny. I'm unable to hear anything outside of the ear buds when anything is playing. Movie Mode seemed to correct all delays and lip synchronization. I'll probably put it on even just with music. The voice assistant brought up Google and Perplexity AI on my phone display. I didn't test that feature any further, but will do a voice call as well. Calling someone, they could hear me loud and clear and I could hear them. If I walk away from my paired phone, it says - "disconnected" so I know I've left my phone elsewhere. This is good actually since I have a habit of doing that when I have ear buds in. Cons: They made for sm aller ears, but seem big anyway. The bud itself is plastic with metalic outside that is visible when you are wearing it. When I first tested I had inserted them into my ears wrong. They should be comfortable, if they aren't twist them to get a more comfortable. Learning how to use them required long tap holds of longest 5 seconds. There is one mode that requires 4 short taps. It was a bit hard to get the hang of the taps and holds and I had made a copy from the back of the box so I could remember because I intended on taking them on a road trip. They didn't respond as easily as I had hoped they would so I had to do extra taps in the beginning due to user error, but all the features worked on 4 separate devices. The technology in these may be older as I've seen reviews back to 2022. Summary: I like them - ear buds haven't progressed a lot over the years. I'm not willing to fork over the money for Sony or Bose etc. This is as close as I can get.
